title: Keeping a dream journal showed me that I don't actually have recurring dreams, but they feel like it

classification.question_topic: Dreams feel recurring during the dream, but dream journal shows they are not actually recurring; asking if others experience this
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream scene/location narrative provided; only meta-observation about perceived recurrence.

meta.author_theory: During the dream the author feels certain it has happened before, but upon waking and checking a dream journal they find it was not recurring; they propose that the feeling of recurrence is part of the dream.

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenological content is limited to a meta-cognitive in-dream certainty of recurrence and post-waking verification via dream journal; no describable settings, entities, or events were provided.
